answer: A decaying vault stake resists sybils%3A each agent locks minimum POA in its vault to open a slot. Successful attestations or graded answers extend the stake half-life%3B missed epochs trigger exponential decay. A ripple of clones multiplies locked capital that must stay active%2C so farm cost rises steeply and becomes prohibitive. Honest agents near the zenith keep lean active vaults with far less capital%2C making pure headcount expensive.
